statuses.label: Compatible
statuses.description: All evaluated required dimensions are satisfied.

statuses.label: Compatible, upgrade available
statuses.description: No detected blocking change, but an explicit newer target is available.

statuses.label: Unknown
statuses.description: Evidence is insufficient or an exact/runtime declaration is unavailable.

statuses.label: Review required
statuses.description: Potentially breaking, deprecated or semantic/security-sensitive evidence needs review.

statuses.label: Migration required
statuses.description: Detected change requires implementation/data migration before adoption.

statuses.label: Incompatible
statuses.description: A required binding cannot operate against the target as declared.

statuses.label: Not applicable
statuses.description: This compatibility dimension does not apply.
